articles.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
articles.snippet: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.

articles.title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
articles.snippet: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.

articles.title: Q-Day Could Arrive Before Quantum Computers Are Commercially Useful, EU Warns
articles.snippet: The threat could arrive before quantum computers are commercially useful, and member states have until the end of 2026 to plan for it.
